action: Organisations that use Arara for mass mailing: check Arara's news page for notices, review which lists were exposed and warn recipients about fraudulent messages.
date_note: ZATAZ page shows last update 18 November 2026; the Osaka report date is not stated, so the publication day is used.
exec: A supplier compromise at an email-sending provider is reported to reach a large city government and other Japanese organisations.
plain: ZATAZ reports that Osaka's city government disclosed an incident that may concern about one million people, tied to a bulk-email provider named Arara.
summary: ZATAZ reports that the City of Osaka disclosed an incident that may concern about one million people, linked to the Arara bulk-email provider. The article says an attack on Arara on 2 November 2026 exposed 77 million email addresses of nearly 400 clients. Arara's own news page, as cited by ZATAZ, says criminals used its service to send millions of fraudulent messages.
title: City of Osaka reports incident tied to Arara bulk-email provider, ZATAZ reports

validation.note: Only ZATAZ was read; Arara's own news page and Osaka's notice were not read.

review.note: Compared about one million people, 2 Nov attack, 77 million addresses, nearly 400 clients, Arara notice as paraphrased and the 18 Nov date note against ZATAZ; single-source status and severity fit
